label: preliminary
method: Recorded RTK-verified ESKF body yaw in the original mapping bag; interpolate in quaternion space.
selected_map_method: Raw Ouster scans transformed with recorded ESKF body yaw and source reference positions, 10ms deskew bins, stride4, 0.2m voxels. IncrementalPointCloud localmap.
simplemap_role: Diagnostic pose-only variant; selected MM was built directly from raw bag, not from this SimpleMap.
validation: 13 held-out raw scans excluded from validation map; paired point-to-point ICP, not full runtime MOLA replay.
